name: small-web
description: The Small Web - The sites and the browser you read them in

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "pnpm --prefix backend run start:dev" "pnpm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --prefix backend run build && pnpm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "pnpm --prefix backend run start:prod" "pnpm --prefix frontend run start"
